_draft: Gift designs: names, lines and art briefs are DRAFTS (12 Oct 2026). Gifts carry their own designs and are not tied to a series; `story` only links to a book that shares the idea. artStyles._draft: DRAFT (15 Oct 2026, John): the 'Art style' row first in the details on every product page. All products are Scandinavian folk art; the technique follows the art. Keyed by theme (the first part of a design's `prompt`), then by product type; a plain string covers every type; a design's own `artStyle` wins. Story Walls: `types.poster.artStyle` in shop.json. Words describe the printed look only (never 'hand-drawn').

halloween.mug: Scandinavian folk art style. Embroidery look: satin-stitch thread texture, French-knot eyes and running-stitch details on white linen, printed on the mug.
halloween.tote: Scandinavian folk art style. Patchwork look: cut-fabric shapes of denim, linen and felt with stitched edges and button eyes, printed flat on the cotton.
halloween.postcards: Scandinavian folk art style. Vintage screen-print look: four flat ink colours, a slight misprint overlap and grainy halftone texture.
halloween.cards: Scandinavian folk art style. Linocut look: bold carved shapes in three colours, visible knife marks and a little ink unevenness.

artStyles.winter: Scandinavian folk art style. Gouache painting texture, dry-brush strokes and a fine printed grain, with folk patterns on the knitwear and botanical ornaments all around.
artStyles.birthday: Scandinavian mid-century folk art style. Gouache painting texture, dry-brush acrylic strokes and visible coloured pencil grain.

_halloween: DRAFT (12 Oct 2026): the Halloween line of cats and dogs, four designs per product (one cat, one dog, many cats, many dogs). `placeholder: true` = no photos yet (a placeholder picture, cannot be ordered). `prompt` points to scripts/catalog/prompts.json; `about` is the picture brief, `line` the one-line card text. No printed words unless John writes them in `words`. Tote bags: 8 designs, each on one colour (4 undyed, 4 black). The older Pim designs were removed on 13 Oct 2026 (John); their URLs 301 to the category pages (vercel.json).
_winter: DRAFT (15 Oct 2026, John): Christmas and New Year cats and dogs, postcards and greeting cards only, four each (two Christmas, two New Year: one cat, one dog, many cats, many dogs), in one whimsical Nordic folk-art style. `prompt` points to the theme `winter` in scripts/catalog/prompts.json. No printed words.
_birthday: DRAFT (15 Oct 2026, John): birthday postcards and greeting cards, eight each: four for girls and four for boys (`child`), a child with a dog, a cat, cats or dogs, in John's own written style. `prompt` points to the theme `birthday` in scripts/catalog/prompts.json. No printed words.
